title: The state directory is deleted while items are pending

steps.why: Finishes at about 20 s, while the daemon is down; the stop is triaged after the restart
The audit log, the reminders and the Lab fact file all go; the item is still pending
A later message: with no dedupe it would carry the worker's key again

expect.name: worker-once
expect.why: What was delivered is a fact of the transcript, not of the state directory

expect.name: decisions-again
expect.text: No decisions are waiting on you.
expect.why: decisions.json went with the state directory; it is a projection, so the next pass wrote it again
